name: Plan-Review Cardinality Enforcement
goal: Make the existing v1.1.2 rule of one blind plan review per plan lineage a durable, restart-safe state-manager invariant.

tasks.name: Persist plan lineage and advance it at design approval
tasks.description: Add additive session/review lineage schema, migration and hook bootstrap parity, then advance lineage exactly once when a design actually enters design_ready. Preserve historical reviews and same-target idempotency.

steps.description: RED: add transition, consume_design rollback injection, migration, historical-row preservation, and real hook-bootstrap tests for plan_lineage; run focused Vitest.
steps.expected: Non-zero RED at the missing plan_lineage seam while existing transition assertions remain green.

steps.description: RED: execute the real session-init hook under a temporary HOME and assert both fresh-schema columns/defaults.
steps.expected: Non-zero RED because session-init does not yet create plan_lineage.

steps.description: GREEN: add plan_lineage to Session and TierUpReviewEntry, additive migrations, fresh schemas, and hook bootstrap without rewriting historical rows.

GREEN: increment lineage in the atomic mark_design_ready transition; wrap consume_design design/session/audit writes in one transaction and increment only for brainstorming to design_ready; never increment for same-target, plan reload, retreat, or reset.
Run both RED commands again and require all lineage/migration/bootstrap assertions green.
Run scoped diff --check, then stage only the seven allowed files.

tasks.name: Enforce one blind review and bind the execution gate to lineage
tasks.description: Reject every second blind review before review/audit mutation, add a SQLite trigger backstop, bind advisor remediation and execution gating to the current lineage, and remove stale re-review instructions.

steps.description: RED: replace the legacy second-review test and add same-hash, changed-hash, formatting, top-tier-self, canonical migrated-row ordering, cross-lineage remediation, new-lineage, immutable-state, fresh/migrated trigger, and error-message cases.
steps.expected: Non-zero RED at duplicate/cross-lineage/message assertions; existing first-review and remediation paths remain green.

steps.description: RED: add bounded get_resume_state review-summary and dispatch tests.
steps.expected: Non-zero RED at the missing resume-state review-summary seam.

steps.description: RED: add executing-plans contract tests that require resume evidence before reviewer dispatch and forbid replacement blind reviews.
steps.expected: Non-zero RED while executing-plans can dispatch before inspecting persisted review state.

steps.description: Add lineage-aware helpers whose canonical blind row is earliest by id ASC, plus fresh/migration trigger installation that tolerates historical duplicates.
Reject second blind verdicts and bare/cross-lineage advisor-remediated before mutation; catch only the trigger's exact race-backstop error.
Extend get_resume_state with bounded current-lineage canonical verdict/hash-match/remediation evidence and expose it through existing read-tool dispatch; add no new tool.

Update executing-plans to branch on persisted resume evidence before reviewer dispatch; skip consumed passing/remediated lineages, resume non-blind remediation after HAS-ISSUES, and fail closed on changed passing-plan hashes or unavailable findings.

Scope start_execution to the canonical current-lineage blind row and current-hash remediation; reject changed-hash passing plans for restoration or verified retreat and remove every fresh/re-review instruction.
Run all three focused GREEN commands, migrated/fresh close-reopen trigger cases, canonical duplicate-order cases, and scoped diff --check.
Stage only the eight allowed files.

tasks.name: Build runtime bundle and run bounded regression verification
tasks.description: Build the executable state-manager bundle, run focused/full/hook regressions, prove source-bundle parity and absence of stale re-review guidance, and record bounded findings.

steps.expected: All resume-state review-summary and dispatch tests pass.

steps.description: Run the existing transition-idempotency hook harness.

Use independent uncapped rg checks for source schema/enforcement, resume evidence, hook bootstrap, bundled runtime, and separate negative stale-guidance checks for executable source/bundle and executing-plans skill.
Write bounded findings with actual RED/GREEN counts, migration/reopen evidence, diff scope, and no-commit/no-push statement.
Run final scoped diff --check and stage only dist/index.js plus the ignored findings artifact.
